ideas.title: Docker Build Fails with COPY: No Such File or Directory When the Context Does Not Include the File
ideas.description: `docker build` stops at `COPY` because the source path is outside the build context or excluded by `.dockerignore`.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact `COPY` error and the source path named by Docker. Explain the build context boundary, how Docker can only copy files sent in the context archive, and why `.dockerignore` can remove a file even when it exists locally. Show how to run the build from the correct directory, fix the `COPY` path, or change the context and ignore rules.

ideas.title: Nginx Proxies the Wrong Upstream URL When `proxy_pass` Uses the Wrong Trailing Slash
ideas.description: Requests reach the upstream app with an unexpected path because `proxy_pass` rewrites the URI differently than intended.
ideas.angle: Begin with the incorrect upstream path or 404 returned by the backend. Explain the URI rewrite rules around `proxy_pass`, especially the difference between including and omitting a trailing slash in the upstream URL, and how that changes path joining. Show the correct location block for preserving or rewriting the request path and how to confirm the final upstream URI.

drafted.title: Next.js Throws a Build Error When a Client Component Imports a Server-Only Module
drafted.description: The App Router build fails because a `'use client'` file pulls server-only code into the client bundle.
drafted.angle: Start with the exact build error and the import chain that leads into the client component. Explain how the App Router splits server and client graphs, why server-only modules can include Node APIs or private data that cannot be bundled for the browser, and how a client boundary changes what can be imported. Show the fix by moving the import behind a server component, using a prop boundary, or replacing the module with a browser-safe alternative.
